description: What a quote of a Luxembourg state needs, one bounded page at a time (at most 50 articles and 96 KiB of text; page or article chooses the page, contents adds the table of contents): each article's text with its digests, the state's permalink, digests, sources and official identities, composed under the rights rule; for an EU act, the same for the wording of the date.
name: evidence_bundle
